title: Spot the loop
description:
Find loops in a list of jumps by looking for jumps that go backwards.

```
0x1010 jl 0x1004    -> back edge: loop from 0x1004 to 0x1010
0x1020 jmp 0x1030   -> forward (an if or a skip)
0x1040 jnz 0x1036   -> back edge: loop from 0x1036 to 0x1040
2 loops, the first one runs a counted loop (cmp before jl)
```
hints: A loop `(a, b)` is inside another `(c, d)` when `c <= a && b <= d` (lesson 9.05).
Compile a `for` loop and a `while` loop of your own and check your tool finds both.
requirements: Each line is an address, a mnemonic and an optional target.
A conditional jump whose target is lower than its address marks a loop body from the target to the jump.
Nested loops: say which loop is inside which.
stretch: Build basic blocks (split at every jump and every jump target).
